frame_contract.destroy: destroy() — empties listener/loop registry, cancels rAF
frame_contract.title: string

architecture.mounting: one game at a time into overlay panel at --z-modal, destroyed on close
architecture.note: Revisit iframe-per-game A2 only if Gemini CLI comes online as second builder

constraints.fake_login: demo label, no name attributes, no storage, preventDefault, bypassable by every visitor; hidden face inert
constraints.fonts: system font stack (no external font files)
constraints.modules: ES modules, relative paths (Pages serves under /repo-name/)
constraints.origin: no request leaves the page's own origin during load or use

events_spec.countdown: target minus now, recomputed each tick (never decrementing)
events_spec.time_source: ctx.now() injected; tests use fake clock (1min before, at start, during, 1min after end, 12h after, DST change)

failure_behavior.injection: ctx.rng and ctx.now injected, real defaults in prod
failure_behavior.no_js: static sections render; games area shows fallback note
failure_behavior.per_loop: try/catch wraps each game tick; on exception destroy game, show 'game crashed, reload', page keeps working
failure_behavior.poster_404: neutral placeholder + title, never broken-image icon
failure_behavior.storage_fallback: try/catch with RAM fallback; show 'scores not saved on this device'
failure_behavior.teardown: frame keeps listener/loop registry; destroy() empties it; test asserts nothing pending
failure_behavior.visibility: pause on hidden tab / open menu / open modal; resume clamps accumulated time to 250ms

pong.ai: paddle max speed below ball speed (beatable)

touch.tetris: on-screen buttons (left, right, rotate, soft drop, hard drop)

gate_rule: done-condition per scene: SCRIPT checks green + MAX checks passed or logged as known issues; failing check → builder alone; two failed rounds on same check → stop, back to stage 3

database.spot_check: Max reviews every row, descriptions in original words

output.reason_line: one line from top two matching dimensions

quiz_spec.widen_strategy: drop lowest-priority filter first (intensity, then time, then players) when fewer than 3 games survive; report what was widened

3.fanout: if Gemini CLI login fixed before scene 3, Pong is its measured job (pong/ only, allocations manifest, Max grades); else Claude Code
3.name: Pong
